name: Banseiki pool: 300 registered people, two human leaders, duplicate exclusion and saved IDs

steps.code:
local rows=DB.ConfigurationQuery("SELECT PersonID, LeaderType, CivilizationType FROM JAC_BanseikiPool")
if #rows~=300 then error('pool count '..#rows) end
local pool={}; for _,r in ipairs(rows) do pool[r.LeaderType]=r end
if not GameConfiguration.IsHotseat() then error('hotseat required') end
local expected={'LEADER_JAC_POOL_H001','LEADER_JAC_POOL_O008'}
for pid=0,1 do
  local c=PlayerConfigurations[pid]; if not c or not c:IsHuman() then error('human slot '..pid) end
  if c:GetLeaderTypeName()~=expected[pid+1] then error('chosen leader '..pid) end
  local p=CreatePlayerParameters(pid,true); p:Refresh()
  local found, registered, duplicate=0,0,false
  for _,v in ipairs(p.Parameters.PlayerLeader.Values) do
    if pool[v.Value] then
      registered=registered+1
      if v.Value==expected[pid+1] and not v.Invalid then found=found+1 end
      if v.Value==expected[2-pid] then duplicate=v.Invalid==true end
    elseif v.Value~='RANDOM' then error('outside pool '..pid..' '..tostring(v.Value)) end
  end
  if found~=1 or registered~=300 or not duplicate then error('pool selection '..pid..' '..registered..' '..found..' '..tostring(duplicate)) end
end
print('[JAC_POOL_TEST] frontend300 twoHuman=2 duplicates=blocked')
return 'frontend300 twoHuman=2 duplicates=blocked'

local version=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BANSEIKI_POOL_LEDGER')
if type(version)~='string' or not version:match('^300:%x+$') then error('saved ledger version missing') end
local expected={'JAC_POOL_H001','JAC_POOL_O008'}
local parts={version}
for pid=0,1 do
 local p=Players[pid]
 if not p or not p:IsHuman() then error('two human players required') end
 local person=p:GetProperty('JAC_POOL_PERSON_ID')
 local trait=p:GetProperty('JAC_POOL_TRAIT')
 local role=p:GetProperty('JAC_POOL_ROLE')
 if person~=expected[pid+1] or type(trait)~='string' or role~='LEADER' then error('person record '..pid..' '..tostring(person)) end
 parts[#parts+1]=table.concat({pid,person,trait,role},'|')
end
print('[JAC_POOL_TEST] restoredRecords '..table.concat(parts,';'))
return table.concat(parts,';')
